question_text: A line graph compares the crime rate (per 100,000 people) and the unemployment rate (%) in a region over time. In 2020, crime rate was 120 and unemployment was 8%. In 2021, crime rate was 110 and unemployment was 9%. In 2022, crime rate was 130 and unemployment was 10%. In 2023, crime rate was 140 and unemployment was 11%. Which year had the highest crime rate relative to unemployment? (Crime rate per 1% unemployment)
